decisions.reason: The existing About-page event adopts the $35 coded-referral reward but leaves the separate coded-referral commission copy at the obsolete $20 amount.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The logic itself sounds good to me.

After 34 mints, the leaderboard now shows 24 tickets and 19 commissions, which is perfect.

The NFT attributes are still not right, though. My screenshots show that NFT #42 has 18 tickets and 9 x $35 commissions on the leaderboard, which is correct. When I open NFT #42, the top of the page also correctly displays 18 tickets and 14 referrals. However, its attributes still report only 6 referrals and $85 in total earnings.

value_updates.coded_referral_commission_copy: State that an accepted referral pays an immediate, unlimited $35 commission to the chosen referrer.
value_updates.coded_referral_rewards_copy: State that using an accepted referral code gives the chosen referrer four tickets and a $35 commission.
value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: State that without a referral code, the recipient selected by the weighted referral draw receives six tickets and a $12 commission.
